request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them). --single

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: The request changes list's default to hide completed todos. The old assertion list(todos) === "[x] milk\n[ ] eggs" described the old show-all default, so it now expects "[ ] eggs". I added an assertion that includeDone: true shows everything, kept the includeDone: false assertion, and renamed the test to match.
